name: Yuki / Lattice
note: Single source for the WebView2 window (style.css :root) and the native Qt ambient surfaces (island, halo, cards, tray). Sizes are logical px at 1x. Colours are sRGB hex; rgba strings carry alpha.

color.rules: live is the only colour and only marks something live: listening, the working head, rec, needs-you, Stop. Primary keys are lit (bone), never coloured.

motion.reducedMotion: draw one static frame; no CSS animation; no blinks

halo.maskShape: ellipse, dots shrink toward the edge

states.listening: ring r=7.6 cells (+-0.3 breathing at 2.4 rad/s), live read head orbiting at 1.9 rad/s, inner ring r=4.6
states.hearing: voice-envelope column field, half-width 24 cells, live crests
states.thinking: 3 comets on a Lissajous path a=8.5, b=3.8 cells
states.working: 5 step segments of 6 cells with 1-cell gaps, current segment fills, live head
states.speaking: one sine ribbon, half-width 26 cells, syllabic envelope at 4.7 rad/s
states.needs-you: 3 live ripples from a solid centre, period 12 cells
states.quiet-in-call: static dotted line with one live dot (0 frames after settle)
states.voice-stopped: broken dotted line with an x
states.done-flash: 2x check stamped column by column (70 ms per column), static after 1.2 s

accent.note: Yuki addition to the Lattice file: the Settings > Accent choice picks the live colour (ui.json 'accent'). 'green' is Lattice's signal mint and the default; 'orange' keeps the older choice working, tuned to the same lightness (10.1:1 on bg). Only color.live, color.liveInk and color.liveDim change.
